headline: New Final Fantasy: Resonance!
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Release Date October 22 | HD-2D Is Back | Gaming News
video_script: A brand new Final Fantasy is almost here! Final Fantasy Resonance launches on October twenty second, twenty twenty six. Square Enix is rebuilding Final Fantasy Brave Exvius as a full console RPG, with H D two D visuals and turn-based combat. It is coming to PS5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2 and PC. Are you a Final Fantasy fan? Comment below!
description: Final Fantasy Resonance launches October 22, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2 and PC. Square Enix rebuilds Final Fantasy Brave Exvius as a console RPG with HD-2D visuals and turn-based combat.
